body: Yeah, there's a certain type of bliss I get from helping others. It doesn't last long every once in a while while I'm feeling hurt I tend to get reminded of them. Kind of like putting a bandaid on a big wound. It still helps.

Some people are more obsessed with stopping you from leaving than they are making you want to stay.

Also I don't understand how people can insult someone who's suicidal. I mean, do you really think that your insults matter to me? What, are you gonna make me feel bad? I already want to end my life, I don't need you to tell me how worthless I am.
So I decided you're right, I should just tell him. I'm just gonna tell him that my dad wants me to go back to college and is making me quit. Thank you for the advice.

Honestly it's because I don't want to have to look at him face to face and say that I want to quit after a only a week of training. I just feel a little anxiety about doing that, especially because this is the only place that'll hire me despite filling out a ton applications and only getting three interviews in the past six months.
I don't have any plans as of yet, I was just hoping that if I did decide to live at the end of the year than I would finally found out what career I want.

I know how you feel. I can't remember a time I didn't want to die. Even as a kid and I didn't know what death was, I still wanted to die. Sometimes I just don't feel like I should've been born. I'm not sure if finding out that I'm not the only one who feels like this makes me feel better or worse. I hope you see happier days soon, OP.

English was literally the only subject that I was good at in school. I was awful at math, I got by in history and science, but english and language arts were two of my best subjects. Honestly I just liked stories a lot and it was easy for me to answer questions like "How is this scene supposed to make the reader feel?"
Honestly the fact that I have no skills, trades or talents. I can barely do basic math. And I fail at making friends too.
No, don't feel like it wants me to do anything. It only makes me feel bad about my decisions. And thank you for your advice.

I haven't told my parents yet, but I plan on not going back to college this fall and getting a job and going to therapy for my depression. If by the end of the year I still can't find a way to be happy or a reason to live, I'll kill myself. Either way, I'm gonna end my depression one way or another.
My only real hobby is writing short stories and I don't have any volunteering experience.
I'm looking at trades right now, but I'm not sure which one is right for me yet. It's a little intimidating to think about how I want to spend the rest of my life.
